SCHOOL DISTRICT CASH RESERVE LEVY INCREASE —— 1 SCHOOL BUDGET YEAR 2026-2027. 2 1. For the school budget year beginning July 1, 2026, a 3 school district for which the taxable value used to calculate 4 school district property taxes for the school budget year 5 beginning July 1, 2025, was reduced by one hundred million 6 dollars or more due to a correction to the taxable value of 7 a single property within the school district made during the 8 school budget year beginning July 1, 2025, may increase the 9 school district’s proposed cash reserve levy under section 10 298.10 to an amount that exceeds the limitations of section 11 298.10, if the district complies with subsection 2. 12 2. A school district that increases its cash reserve levy 13 pursuant to this section shall also reduce one or more other 14 property tax levies of the school district, including the 15 district management levy under section 298.4, by a total amount 16 equal to or greater than the increase in the cash reserve 17 levy so that the total property tax dollars for all property 18 tax levies of the school district does not exceed the school 19 district’s combined amount of property tax dollars determined 20 under section 24.2A, subsection 2, paragraph “b”, subparagraph 21 (3). 22 3. A school district that wishes to adjust its levy rates 23 pursuant to this section shall notify the department of 24 management in a manner prescribed by the department. Following 25 receipt of the notice from the school district, the department 26 of management shall adjust the school district’s property tax 27 levy rates as necessary to implement this section. 28 Sec. 2. EFFECTIVE DATE.
